title: P1-P2 Frontend 测试深化 (浅层 store 测试加深 + hooks 覆盖)
description: 为 P1-P2 frontend 层深化现有浅层测试：(1) 识别并加深 top 5 浅层 store 测试（仅覆盖 happy path 的测试），补充错误路径和边界条件；(2) 为 top 10 最常用 hooks 补全测试。遵循 companion pattern 扩展而非重写。
action: Create .additional.test.ts and/or .branches.additional.test.ts companion files for top 5 shallow store tests; create hook test files for top 10 most-used hooks under desktop/src/stores/app/ or desktop/src/hooks/

criteria: At least 3 new .additional.test.ts or .branches.additional.test.ts files exist under desktop/src/stores/app/
Each new companion test file contains "describe('" with 'additional' or 'branch' in describe name
At least 3 new hook test files exist under desktop/src/
cd desktop && npx vitest run src/stores/app/ --reporter=verbose exits 0
cd desktop && npx vitest run src/hooks/ --reporter=verbose 2>&1 does not contain 'SKIP' or 'TODO'
convergence.verification: Run vitest for all store tests in desktop/ and confirm all pass. Grep for new companion test files and hook test files to verify creation.
convergence.definition_of_done: Top 5 浅层 store 测试已通过 companion 文件加深（错误路径+边界条件），top 10 常用 hooks 有基础测试覆盖，所有测试通过

files.change: Create companion test covering: error paths in async intelligence actions, edge cases for intelligence state transitions, boundary conditions for empty/null intelligence data
Create companion test covering: workflow execution error paths, edge cases for workflow state (pending/running/completed/failed), concurrent workflow scenarios
Create companion test covering: template loading error paths, empty template list handling, duplicate template scenarios, invalid template data
Create test for conversation-related hooks: hook rendering, state selection, action dispatch verification
Create test for workspace-related hooks: workspace context access, workspace mutation hooks
Create test for loading state hooks: loading state subscription, start/finish lifecycle

implementation: Read existing store test files to identify top 5 shallow tests: intelligenceSlice.test.ts, workflowSlice.test.ts, templateSlice.test.ts, projectSlice.test.ts, shared.test.ts — assess which have error/edge case gaps

For each shallow store test: read the source slice file, identify uncovered branches (error paths, null/undefined inputs, concurrent mutations), create .branches.additional.test.ts companion with targeted coverage
Identify top 10 most-used hooks by reading desktop/src/hooks/ directory and checking import frequency across components
For hook tests: use @testing-library/react-hooks or vitest's renderHook pattern, test hook state selection, action dispatch, and cleanup behavior
Verify all new test files pass with vitest run

commands: cd desktop && npx vitest run src/stores/app/ --reporter=verbose
cd desktop && npx vitest run src/hooks/ --reporter=verbose

reference.pattern: Companion test pattern (.branches.additional.test.ts) + React hook testing with renderHook

rationale.chosen_approach: Deepen existing shallow tests via companion pattern (per Locked constraint #1) rather than rewriting test structure. Hook tests are grouped by domain to minimize file count.
decision_factors: Existing store tests cover happy paths but miss error paths and edge cases
Hook tests are a known coverage gap (top 10 most-used hooks have zero direct test coverage)
Companion pattern preserves existing test structure while adding depth
Free constraint: hook test priority order is at implementer discretion
rationale.tradeoffs: Deepening 5 shallow tests and adding 10 hook tests is substantial work — grouped into one task to reduce agent spawn overhead, but may need 50-60 minutes of focused implementation

risks: Hook tests may require React testing library setup — check if @testing-library/react-hooks or similar is installed
Some hooks may depend on complex Zustand store state — harness setup may be non-trivial
Identifying 'top 5 shallow' and 'top 10 most-used' requires codebase analysis that may reveal different files than expected
